description: Brings an archived event (an id from list_events with archived:true) back to the live list — the dashboard's own "Restore". An event whose dates are all past is archived again by the nightly sweep; add a future date to keep it. Sends nothing itself, but a restored open autopilot event rejoins the automatic reminders to guests who haven't answered, so restoring one needs the send permission too; any other event needs only the write permission.

event_id.description: An archived event's id, from list_events with archived:true

name: restore_event
title: Restore an archived event
